name: Crón

attributes.attribute: an Irish divinity named as the dark one

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Crón is a fading Irish divinity. Several texts mark her as the dark one or the swarthy one. She has ties to a great serpent, the creature perhaps called Caoranach. Lore rests her in an enchanted dell named Crón's Glen.

okr.objective: Crón is an obscure Irish divinity of the dark bound to a great serpent.
key_results: The texts call her the dark or swarthy one.
She has ties to a giant serpent, perhaps Caoranach.
Her home is an enchanted dell carrying her name.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
